narratives.Description: Finish PR #5 by reconciling live repository authoring-pin verifiers with the already-upgraded exact @deftai/directive 0.119.1 root dependency.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive training maintainer, I want the framework upgrade and its executable repository contracts to agree, so that the native build matrix passes without rewriting the curriculum's intentional 0.112.0 learner baseline or historical evidence.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Update every live root-package exact-version assertion from 0.112.0 to 0.119.1 and only the focused test fixtures or mutations that represent the root authoring package. Preserve learner fixture pins, curriculum baseline claims, completed xBRIEFs, and historical source evidence at 0.112.0. Run all repository content checks and focused tests plus the canonical Deft gate. Push one coherent review-fix batch, require green native CI and a fresh Greptile 5/5 review on the current head, reply to and resolve every review conversation, and stop before merge.
narratives.Acceptance: All live root-package verifiers require @deftai/directive 0.119.1 exactly; learner and historical 0.112.0 contracts remain unchanged; all local content checks, focused tests, and the Deft aggregate gate pass; PR #5 native CI is green; Greptile reports 5/5 on the current head with no P0 or P1 findings; and all review conversations are addressed and resolved.
narratives.Safety: Do not change learner fixture dependency graphs, authored 0.112.0 curriculum claims, completed delivery records, repository identity, visibility, remotes, merge state, publication surfaces, or upstream deftai/directive. All GitHub commands and pushes run as dbcall2.
narratives.Traces: David's explicit requests to upgrade Directive, fix the failed build, reach Greptile 5/5, and address and resolve all conversations; PR #5 review thread PRRT_kwDOUdwfdc6jKw6e; PROJECT-DEFINITION SourceOfTruth, DirectiveBaseline, DevelopmentPosture, and ProjectRules, with the live operator instruction overriding the project Greptile default for this PR only.
narratives.QualityGate: Run the complete check:* and test:* package-script surfaces, task deft:check, git diff --check, native GitHub Actions on the final head, and a fresh dual-source Greptile review read on that same head.
